mapper.select: SELECT id, device_id AS "deviceId", CAST(metric_data -> 'cpu_usage' AS TEXT) AS "metricValueJson", timestamp FROM metrics WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND timestamp >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '15 minutes' AND timestamp <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND metric_data -> 'cpu_usage' IS NOT NULL AND metric_data -> 'cpu_usage' != 'null'::jsonb ORDER BY timestamp ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, device_id AS "deviceId", CAST(metric_data -> 'ram_usage_percent' AS TEXT) AS "metricValueJson", timestamp FROM metrics WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND timestamp >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '15 minutes' AND timestamp <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND metric_data -> 'ram_usage_percent' IS NOT NULL AND metric_data -> 'ram_usage_percent' != 'null'::jsonb ORDER BY timestamp ASC, id ASC
